title: Meet your host
text:
Meet your host for dinner in Fresno.

Josh Stech, co-founder and CEO of Sundae, has spent his career at the intersection of technology and residential real estate. Before Sundae, Josh was a founding partner at LendingHome and co-founded Purpose Built Investments, launching three funds. Josh is an angel investor in 107 companies.

Wednesday, Nov. 18 · 6-8:30 p.m. PT · Fresno, with Stratton Brown of Deal Champs. Dinner served; seats are limited.
